description: Moving an existential quantifier through conjunction or a universal quantifier through disjunction past an independent formula remains valid even if the domain is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.moving_quantifiers_empty_allowed.{u, v, w, u'}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (θ : L.BoundedFormula α (n + 1))
  (χ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  ((θ.ex ⊓ χ).Realize a b ↔ (θ ⊓ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ).ex.Realize a b) ∧
    ((θ.all ⊔ χ).Realize a b ↔ (θ ⊔ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ).all.Realize a b)
